notes: This is a national occupational standard and competency-based curriculum, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.

One standard (K72S004) packages three qualifications: NVQ Level 2 Data Entry Operator, NVQ Level 3 Computer Application Assistant and NVQ Level 4 ICT Technician. Each linked record stores only the units its own package requires.

Unit 1 is titled 'Use the computer and manage files within standard operating systems' in the List of Competency Units but 'Handle computer and files within standard operating systems' on its unit page; the list title is stored.
'inpterpersonal' (BU01) is stored as published. The curriculum's competency-profile page carries an unrelated 'FLIGHT DISPATCHER' heading, a source error.
Only unit titles are stored; elements, performance criteria and the curriculum modules (e.g. network issues in competencies G6/G7) are not.
Stores the NVQ Level 4 ICT Technician package (K72S004Q3L4): all 15 units.
scope_verbatim: National Certificate at NVQ Level 4 in the occupation of Information and Communication Technology Technician will be awarded to those who are competent in U01 + U02 + U03 + U04 + U05 + U06 + U07 + U08 + U09 +U10 +U11 + BU01 + BU02 + BU03 + BU04 – K72S004Q3L4

notes: A national qualification, not a delivered programme; no delivering provider has been verified and no nominal duration is stated.
Requires 12 units (6 core, 6 elective). Only the 6 core units are stored; electives such as word processing, spreadsheets and databases are optional and are not assessed as coverage.
A foundation (pathways) qualification at AQF Certificate II; it is a content comparator only.
Codex's earlier download of ICT30120 was Release 1 (2020), a superseded release; ICT30120's current core units are generic and were not used.
scope_verbatim: This pathways qualification provides the foundation skills and knowledge to use basic applied digital technologies in varied contexts.
